question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Grotesque".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Attractive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Grotesque" means strange, ugly, or distorted in an unnatural or shocking way. (घृणित/भद्दा)

◦ Example: The old carved masks had grotesque faces meant to frighten evil spirits away from the village.

 

• "Attractive" means pleasing to look at; appealing or good-looking, and is therefore the correct antonym. (आकर्षक)

◦ Example: Tourists found the newly restored palace far more attractive than the old crumbling ruins nearby.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Hideous (घिनौना): extremely ugly or unpleasant to look at — a synonym of grotesque, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Distorted (विकृत): twisted out of natural shape — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Bizarre (विचित्र): very strange or unusual in appearance — close in sense to grotesque.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of grotesque: Bizarre, Distorted, Hideous, Deformed, Monstrous.

• Synonyms of attractive: Appealing, Charming, Beautiful, Handsome.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Prosperity (समृद्धि): Poverty (गरीबी), Failure (असफलता)

2. Prudent (समझदार): Thoughtless (अविवेकी), Careless (लापरवाह)

3. Puissant (शक्तिशाली): Feeble (कमजोर), Weak (दुर्बल)

4. Pulchritude (सुंदरता): Ugliness (कुरूपता), Plainness (साधारणता)

5. Pulverize (चूर्ण करना): Restore (पुनः स्थापित करना), Repair (मरम्मत करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Extinguished."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Ignited.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Extinguished" means put out; caused a fire or light to stop burning. (बुझा हुआ)

 

• "Ignited" means set on fire; caused to start burning. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रज्वलित)

◦ Example: A stray spark from the machinery ignited the pile of dry hay stored inside the barn.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Doused (बुझाया) — extinguished by covering or drowning with liquid; a synonym of extinguished.

• Option 3: Quenched (बुझाया) — put out a fire or thirst; a synonym of extinguished.

• Option 4: Snuffed (बुझा दिया) — extinguished a flame quickly; a synonym of extinguished.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of extinguished: Lit, Kindled, Sparked.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Purify (शुद्ध करना): Pollute (प्रदूषित करना), Contaminate (दूषित करना)

2. Purportedly (कथित रूप से): Impossibly (असंभव रूप से)

3. Pusillanimous (कायर): Brave (साहसी), Courageous (वीर)

4. Quaint (अनोखा / प्यारा): Ordinary (सामान्य), Common (साधारण)

5. Quell (दबाना): Provoke (भड़काना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Rectify."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Worsen.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Rectify" means to put right or correct something that is wrong. (सुधारना)

 

• "Worsen" means to make or become worse. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बिगाड़ना)

◦ Example: Ignoring the small leak will only worsen the damage to the ceiling over time.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Amend (संशोधित करना) — to make minor changes to improve something; a synonym of rectify.

• Option 2: Correct (ठीक करना) — to make something accurate or right; a synonym of rectify.

• Option 3: Remedy (उपचार करना) — to correct or improve a bad situation; a synonym of rectify.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of rectify: Damage, Aggravate, Exacerbate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quixotic (अव्यावहारिक): Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी)

2. Rampart (किले की दीवार): Ditch (खाई), Opening (खुला स्थान)

3. Random (अनियमित): Systematic (सुव्यवस्थित), Planned (योजनाबद्ध)

4. Ravaged (विनष्ट): Restored (पुनःस्थापित)

5. Rebarbative (अप्रिय / अरुचिकर): Attractive (आकर्षक), Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Amazed."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Unimpressed.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Amazed" means filled with great surprise, wonder, or astonishment. (आश्चर्यचकित)

 

• "Unimpressed" means not impressed; feeling no admiration or interest. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रभावित नहीं)

◦ Example: The critics remained unimpressed by the film's predictable plot and shallow characters.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Astonished (चकित) — greatly surprised or amazed; a synonym of amazed.

• Option 2: Awestruck (विस्मित) — filled with awe or wonder; a synonym of amazed.

• Option 3: Astounded (हतप्रभ) — shocked or greatly surprised; a synonym of amazed.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of amazed: Indifferent, Unmoved.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Rebellion (विद्रोह): Loyalty (निष्ठा)

2. Recalcitrance (अवज्ञा): Compliance (आज्ञापालन), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता)

3. Receive (प्राप्त करना): Give (देना), Send (भेजना)

4. Recount (बयान करना): Suppress (दबाना), Conceal (छिपाना)

5. Rectify (सुधारना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Damage (हानि करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Exemplary."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Unsatisfactory.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Exemplary" means serving as a desirable model; outstandingly good. (अनुकरणीय)

 

• "Unsatisfactory" means not good enough; failing to meet expectations or requirements. It is therefore the correct antonym. (असंतोषजनक)

◦ Example: The manager criticized the unsatisfactory quality of the products delivered by the new supplier.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Commendable (प्रशंसनीय) — deserving praise; a synonym of exemplary.

• Option 3: Flawless (निर्दोष) — without any imperfections; a synonym of exemplary.

• Option 4: Model (आदर्श) — serving as a perfect example; a synonym of exemplary.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of exemplary: Poor, Inadequate, Substandard.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Redeem (सुधारना): Forfeit (गंवाना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना)

2. Redolent (सुगंधित): Unscented (बिना गंध), Odorless (गंधहीन)

3. Refulgent (चमकदार): Dull (फीका), Dim (मंद)

4. Refuse (मना करना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Permit (अनुमति देना)

5. Relevant (प्रासंगिक): Inappropriate (अनुचित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Optimistic."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Gloomy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Optimistic" means hopeful and confident about the future. (आशावादी)

 

• "Gloomy" means dark, dismal, or feeling despondent about the future. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदास)

◦ Example: The economist painted a gloomy picture of the country's prospects for the coming year.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Upbeat (उत्साही) — cheerful and optimistic; a synonym of optimistic.

• Option 3: Positive (सकारात्मक) — constructive and confident in outlook; a synonym of optimistic.

• Option 4: Hopeful (आशान्वित) — feeling or inspiring optimism; a synonym of optimistic.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of optimistic: Pessimistic, Despondent, Dismal.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Relinquish (त्यागना): Retain (रखना), Continue (जारी रखना)

2. Reluctant (अनिच्छुक): Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Willing (तैयार)

3. Reprobate (अनैतिक व्यक्ति): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Moral (नैतिक)

4. Repudiate (त्यागना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना)

5. Repulsive (घृणित): Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Sagacious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Foolish.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Sagacious" means having or showing keen judgment and wisdom. (बुद्धिमान)

◦ Example: The sagacious old professor offered advice that guided generations of students through difficult career decisions.

 

• "Foolish" means lacking good sense or judgment, and is therefore the correct antonym. (मूर्ख)

◦ Example: Investing his entire savings in one risky stock was a foolish decision he soon regretted.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Astute (चालाक): having keen insight and good judgment — a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Wise (विवेकी): having experience, knowledge, and good judgment — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Shrewd (चतुर): having sharp judgment, especially in practical matters — close in sense to sagacious.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of sagacious: wise, shrewd, astute, perceptive, judicious.

• Synonyms of foolish: silly, unwise, senseless, imprudent, stupid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Resilient (मजबूत): Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर)

2. Retired (सेवानिवृत्त): Active (सक्रिय), Working (कार्यरत)

3. Reverence (सम्मान): Contempt (तिरस्कार), Scorn (घृणा)

4. Risible (हंसने योग्य): Serious (गंभीर), Grave (गंभीर)

5. Rowdy (उपद्रवी): Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Calm (शांत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Random".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Systematic.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Random" means made or done without method or conscious decision. (अनियमित)

◦ Example: The survey selected participants at random to ensure the results were statistically fair and unbiased.

 

• "Systematic" means done according to a fixed plan or system, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सुव्यवस्थित)

◦ Example: The researchers followed a systematic approach, recording every measurement in the same careful order.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Haphazard (अव्यवस्थित): lacking any order or organization — a synonym of random, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Arbitrary (मनमाना): based on random choice rather than reason — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Chance (संयोग): happening by accident rather than design — close in sense to random.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of random: haphazard, arbitrary, chance, erratic, unsystematic.

• Synonyms of systematic: methodical, organized, structured, orderly, planned.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ruthless (निर्दयी): Compassionate (दयालु), Kind (कृपालु)

2. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (अविवेकी)

3. Sanguine (आशावादी): Melancholic (निराश), Pessimistic (निराशावादी)

4. Scared (डरा हुआ): Brave (साहसी), Fearless (निर्भय)

5. Scary (डरावना): Comforting (सांत्वनादायक), Reassuring (आश्वस्त करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Babble."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Quiet.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Babble" means talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish or incomprehensible way. (बकबक करना)

 

• "Quiet" means making little or no noise; silent. It is therefore the correct antonym. (शांत)

◦ Example: After the long lecture, the students became quiet as the teacher began handing out the surprise test.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Ramble (अनर्गल बोलना) — talk at length in a confused or aimless way; a synonym of babble.

• Option 2: Chatter (बकबक करना) — talk rapidly and continuously about trivial matters; a synonym of babble.

• Option 4: Prattle (बकवास करना) — chatter foolishly or at unnecessary length; a synonym of babble.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of babble: Silence, Hush, Stillness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Scattered (बिखरा): Gathered (इकट्ठा), Collected (संग्रहित)

2. Scrupulous (ईमानदार / नैतिक): Immoral (अनैतिक), Dishonest (बेईमान)

3. Searing (जलाना/तेज़ गर्म): Freezing (जमाने वाला/ठंडा), Cold (ठंडा)

4. Secure (सुरक्षित): Insecure (असुरक्षित), Unsafe (असुरक्षित)

5. Seldom (कभी-कभी): Frequently (अक्सर), Often (बार-बार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Emaciated."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Healthy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Emaciated" means abnormally thin or weak, especially from illness or lack of food. (दुबला/कमजोर)

 

• "Healthy" means in good physical condition; free from illness. It is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वस्थ)

◦ Example: Regular exercise and a balanced diet helped him stay healthy well into his seventies.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Skeletal (कंकाल जैसा) — extremely thin, like a skeleton; a synonym of emaciated.

• Option 3: Undernourished (कुपोषित) — not having enough food to be healthy; a synonym of emaciated.

• Option 4: Gaunt (दुबला-पतला) — thin and haggard, especially from suffering; a synonym of emaciated.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of emaciated: Fatty, Robust, Well-fed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Selective (चयनशील): Careless (लापरवाह), Indiscriminate (भेदभाव रहित)

2. Sell (बेचना): Buy (खरीदना), Purchase (खरीदना)

3. Serene (शांत): Chaotic (अशांत), Turbulent (उथल-पुथल)

4. Servile (चापलूस): Arrogant (घमंडी), Independent (स्वतंत्र)

5. Shallow (उथला): Deep (गहरा)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Nascent".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Withering.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Nascent" means just beginning to exist or develop; emerging. (प्रारंभिक)

◦ Example: The nascent tech startup attracted several investors eager to fund its promising new idea.

 

• "Withering" means declining sharply, drying up, or losing vitality, and is therefore the correct antonym. (मुरझाया हुआ)

◦ Example: The withering economy forced thousands of small businesses to close within just a few months.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Emerging (उभरता हुआ): beginning to become apparent — a synonym of nascent, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Budding (अंकुरित होता हुआ): beginning to develop or grow — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Incipient (आरंभिक): in an early stage of existence — close in sense to nascent.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of nascent: Emerging, Budding, Incipient, Developing, Fledgling.

• Synonyms of withering: Declining, Dying, Fading, Decaying.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Shrink (सिकुड़ना): Expand (फैलना), Grow (बढ़ना)

2. Slander (बदनाम करना): Praise (प्रशंसा), Appreciate (सराहना)

3. Slender (पतला): Stout (मोटा), Thick (मोटा)

4. Sloppy (मैला/लापरवाह): Dashing (सजावटी/स्मार्ट), Neat (साफ-सुथरा)

5. Sluggish (सुस्त): Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Exultant."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Disconsolate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Exultant" means triumphantly happy or joyful, especially after a success. (उल्लसित)

 

• "Disconsolate" means deeply unhappy and unable to be comforted. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदास)

◦ Example: The disconsolate team sat silently in the locker room, still stunned by their last-minute defeat.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Jubilant (प्रसन्नचित्त) — feeling great happiness after a success; a synonym of exultant.

• Option 2: Triumphant (विजयी) — having won a battle or contest; a synonym of exultant.

• Option 3: Elated (उल्लासित) — extremely happy and excited; a synonym of exultant.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of exultant: Miserable, Dejected, Sorrowful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sneer (उपहास करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Respect (सम्मान करना)

2. Solicit (मदद माँगना): Prohibit (मना करना), Forbid (प्रतिबंध लगाना)

3. Somnolent (निद्रालु): Awake (जाग्रत), Alert (सतर्क)

4. Sophisticated (उन्नत): Primitive (आदिम), Simple (सरल)

5. Soporific (नींद लाने वाला): Stimulating (उत्तेजक), Energizing (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Advance."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Retreat.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Advance" means to move forward or make progress, often purposefully. (आगे बढ़ना)

 

• "Retreat" means to withdraw from a position due to difficulty or defeat. It is therefore the correct antonym. (पीछे हटना)

◦ Example: Facing overwhelming resistance, the army was forced to retreat to its original defensive position.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Progress (प्रगति करना) — to move forward or develop steadily; a synonym of advance.

• Option 3: Forge ahead (दृढ़ता से आगे बढ़ना) — to move forward with determination; a synonym of advance.

• Option 4: Proceed (आगे बढ़ना) — to continue forward with an activity; a synonym of advance.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of advance: Withdraw, Recede.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sporadic (अनियमित): Frequent (बार-बार), Regular (नियमित)

2. Spurious (नकली): Authentic (असली), Genuine (वास्तविक)

3. Squirm (घबराना/बेचैन होना): Relax (आराम करना), Calm (शांत रहना)

4. Stale (बासी): Fresh (ताज़ा), New (नया)

5. Staunch (दृढ़): Unsteady (अस्थिर), Weak (कमज़ोर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Accept".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Deny.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Accept" means to willingly receive, agree to, or believe something offered. (स्वीकार करना)

◦ Example: She decided to accept the job offer after weighing the salary against the long commute.

 

• "Deny" means to state that something is not true; to refuse to grant, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अस्वीकार करना)

◦ Example: The official continued to deny any involvement in the scandal despite mounting evidence.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Agree (सहमत होना): to have the same opinion or give consent — a synonym of accept, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Consent (सहमति देना): to give permission for something to happen — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Approve (स्वीकृति देना): to officially confirm something as satisfactory — close in sense to accept.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of accept: Agree, Approve, Consent, Acknowledge, Embrace.

• Synonyms of deny: Reject, Refuse, Decline, Dispute, Disallow.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Strange (अजीब): Mundane (साधारण), Familiar (परिचित)

2. Strenuous (कठिन/जोरदार): Easy (आसान), Effortless (सरल)

3. Strong (मजबूत): Weak (कमजोर), Fragile (नाजुक)

4. Stunning (आश्चर्यजनक): Mundane (साधारण), Ordinary (सामान्य)

5. Sublime (उत्कृष्ट): Mediocre (साधारण), Inferior (निम्न)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Identity."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Anonymous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Identity" means the fact of being who or what a person or thing is; individual character. (पहचान)

 

• "Anonymous" means not identified by name; of unknown or undisclosed identity. It is therefore the correct antonym. (गुमनाम)

◦ Example: An anonymous donor contributed a large sum of money to the hospital's children's ward.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Personality (व्यक्तित्व) — characteristics that form an individual's character; a synonym of identity.

• Option 3: Individuality (विशिष्टता) — the character that distinguishes one from others; a synonym of identity.

• Option 4: Selfhood (स्वत्व) — the quality of being an individual self; a synonym of identity.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of identity: Unnamed, Unidentified, Nameless.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Subterfuge (छल): Candor (स्पष्टवादिता), Honesty (ईमानदारी)

2. Success (सफलता): Failure (असफलता), Defeat (पराजय)

3. Superficial (सतही): Profound (गहरा), Deep (गंभीर)

4. Superfluous (अनावश्यक / फालतू): Essential (आवश्यक), Necessary (जरूरी)

5. Suppress (दबाना): Incite (उकसाना), Reveal (प्रकट करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Imbroglio".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Agreement.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Imbroglio" means an extremely confused, complicated, or embarrassing situation. (उलझन / जटिल स्थिति)

◦ Example: The scandal turned into a political imbroglio that dominated the headlines for several weeks.

 

• "Agreement" means a state in which people share the same opinion; harmony or accord, and is therefore the correct antonym. (समझौता)

◦ Example: After hours of negotiation, both parties finally reached an agreement on the terms of the contract.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Muddle (गड़बड़ी): a state of confusion or disorder — a synonym of imbroglio, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Entanglement (उलझन): a complicated or compromising situation — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Predicament (कठिन स्थिति): a difficult, unpleasant situation — close in sense to imbroglio.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of imbroglio: entanglement, predicament, muddle, confusion, quandary.

• Synonyms of agreement: accord, harmony, consensus, concord, unity.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Surreptitious (गुप्त): Overt (खुला), Open (स्पष्ट)

2. Sustainability (स्थिरता): Indefensibility (अस्थिरता/असुरक्षित स्थिति)

3. Sustenance (जीविका): Starvation (भूखमरी), Deprivation (वंचना)

4. Sweet (मीठा): Bitter (कड़वा), Sour (खट्टा)

5. Synthetic (कृत्रिम): Natural (प्राकृतिक), Genuine (वास्तविक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Mesmerize."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Repel.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Mesmerize" means to hold someone's complete attention as though by magic. (आकर्षित करना)

 

• "Repel" means to cause strong dislike or disgust; to drive away. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दूर करना)

◦ Example: The foul smell from the swamp was enough to repel even the most curious explorers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Enthrall (मंत्रमुग्ध करना) — capture the fascinated attention; a synonym of mesmerize.

• Option 3: Captivate (मोहित करना) — attract and hold interest; a synonym of mesmerize.

• Option 4: Fascinate (आकर्षित करना) — attract intense interest; a synonym of mesmerize.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of mesmerize: Disgust, Repulse, Deter.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Taboo (वर्जित): Acceptable (स्वीकृत)

2. Tacit (अव्यक्त): Explicit (स्पष्ट), Expressed (प्रकट)

3. Taciturn (कम बोलने वाला): Talkative (बातूनी), Verbose (अधिक बोलने वाला)

4. Tangible (मूर्त): Intangible (अमूर्त), Abstract (अव्यक्त)

5. Tardy (सुस्त/देरी से): Prompt (समय पर), Quick (तेज)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Nugatory."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Significant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Nugatory" means of no value or importance; trifling. (महत्वहीन)

 

• "Significant" means sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention. It is therefore the correct antonym. (महत्वपूर्ण)

◦ Example: Losing the star player was a significant setback for the team heading into the finals.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Trivial (तुच्छ) — of little value or importance; a synonym of nugatory.

• Option 2: Invalid (अमान्य) — having no legal or binding force; a synonym of nugatory.

• Option 4: Worthless (बेकार) — having no real value; a synonym of nugatory.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of nugatory: Important, Productive, Valuable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tedious (उबाऊ / थकाऊ): Exciting (रोचक), Engaging (आकर्षक)

2. Tenacious (जिद्दी / दृढ़): Yielding (झुकने वाला), Weak (कमजोर)

3. Tenebrous (अंधकारमय): Bright (उज्ज्वल), Clear (स्पष्ट)

4. Thwart (विफल करना): Assist (सहायता करना), Help (मदद करना)

5. Timid (डरपोक): Daring (साहसी), Bold (निडर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Retired".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Active.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Retired" means having left one's job permanently, usually due to age. (सेवानिवृत्त)

◦ Example: My retired grandfather now spends most of his mornings gardening and reading in the sun.

 

• "Active" means engaged in full-time work or physical activity, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सक्रिय)

◦ Example: Despite his age, he remains an active member of the company's senior management team.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Emeritus (मानद सेवानिवृत्त): retired but retaining an honorary title — a synonym of retired, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Pensioned (पेंशनभोगी): receiving a pension after retirement — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Superannuated (अतिवृद्ध): retired or too old for further work — close in sense to retired.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of retired: pensioned, superannuated, emeritus, inactive, former.

• Synonyms of active: working, employed, engaged, functioning, operative.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Torpor (सुस्ती): Liveliness (सजीवता), Activity (सक्रियता)

2. Traditional (परम्परागत): Modern (आधुनिक), Unusual (असामान्य)

3. Traitor (देशद्रोही): Loyal (वफादार), Patriot (देशभक्त)

4. Transient (क्षणिक): Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (दीर्घकालिक)

5. Transitory (अस्थायी): Eternal (स्थायी), Permanent (स्थायी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Contracts".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Expands.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Contracts" means becomes smaller or reduces in size. (सिकुड़ना)

◦ Example: Metal contracts when it cools, which is why engineers leave small gaps in railway tracks.

 

• "Expands" means becomes larger in size, number, or amount, and is therefore the correct antonym. (फैलना)

◦ Example: The economy expands rapidly when consumer spending and business investment both increase together.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Shrinks (सिकुड़ता है): becomes smaller in size — a synonym of contracts, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Reduces (कम होता है): becomes smaller in amount — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Diminishes (घटता है): becomes less or smaller — close in sense to contracts.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of contracts: shrinks, reduces, diminishes, narrows, condenses.

• Synonyms of expands: grows, enlarges, widens, increases, extends.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Trepidation (घबराहट): Calm (शांत), Relaxed (आरामदायक)

2. Triumph (विजय): Defeat (पराजय), Failure (असफलता)

3. Triumphant (विजयी): Defeated (पराजित), Unsuccessful (असफल)

4. Trivial (तुच्छ): Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Significant (जरूरी)

5. Truculent (लड़ाकू): Amiable (मिलनसार), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Obfuscate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Clarify.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Obfuscate" means to make something unclear or difficult to understand deliberately. (अस्पष्ट करना)

◦ Example: The lawyer seemed to obfuscate the contract's key terms with unnecessarily complicated legal jargon.

 

• "Clarify" means to make something clearer or easier to understand, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्पष्ट करना)

◦ Example: The teacher paused the lecture to clarify a difficult point before moving on to the next topic.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Muddle (गड़बड़ करना): confuse something in a disorderly way — a synonym of obfuscate, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Obscure (अस्पष्ट करना): make something difficult to perceive — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Confuse (भ्रमित करना): make something unclear or muddled — close in sense to obfuscate.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of obfuscate: Confuse, Muddle, Obscure, Blur, Complicate.

• Synonyms of clarify: Explain, Illuminate, Simplify, Elucidate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tumult (शोर-शराबा): Calmness (शांति), Silence (मौन)

2. Turbulent (अशांत): Calm (शांत), Peaceful (सुकून भरा)

3. Turpitude (अनैतिकता): Morality (नैतिकता), Virtue (सदाचार)

4. Uncomfortable (असुविधाजनक): Comfortable (आरामदायक), Easy (सहज)

5. Undesirable (अवांछनीय): Advisable (उचित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Ensconce".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Unveil.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Ensconce" means to settle or establish someone or something securely and comfortably. (छिपाना)

◦ Example: The family managed to ensconce themselves comfortably in the cozy mountain cabin for the winter.

 

• "Unveil" means to remove a covering from something in order to reveal it, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रकट करना)

◦ Example: The mayor will unveil the new statue in the city square during tomorrow's ceremony.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Lodge (ठहराना): to provide with a place to stay — a synonym of ensconce, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Install (स्थापित करना): to place someone or something in a position — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Settle (बसाना): to establish someone in a comfortable position — close in sense to ensconce.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of ensconce: Settle, Install, Establish, Lodge, Position.

• Synonyms of unveil: Disclose, Expose, Reveal, Uncover, Display.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Unprecedented (अभूतपूर्व): Familiar (परिचित)

2. Unsure (अनिश्चित): Certain (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का)

3. Upright (ईमानदार): Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Dishonest (बेईमान)

4. Usurp (हड़पना): Restore (वापस करना), Surrender (समर्पण करना)

5. Utterly (पूरी तरह): Minimally (न्यूनतम), Slightly (थोड़ा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Demented."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Sensible.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Demented" means suffering from severe mental impairment; mad or insane. (पागल)

 

• "Sensible" means having or showing reasonable judgment; sound and practical. It is therefore the correct antonym. (समझदार)

◦ Example: It was a sensible decision to buy travel insurance before embarking on such a long and unpredictable journey.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Deranged (विक्षिप्त) — mad or seriously disturbed in mind; a synonym of demented.

• Option 2: Insane (पागल) — seriously mentally ill; not sane; a synonym of demented.

• Option 4: Crazy (सनकी) — mentally unstable or irrational; a synonym of demented.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of demented: Rational, Reasonable, Practical.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vacillate (डगमगाना): Decide (निर्णय लेना), Resolve (निश्चित करना)

2. Vain (घमंडी/अहंकारी): Humble (नम्र), Modest (विनम्र)

3. Vehement (तीव्र/जोरदार): Mild (मंद), Gentle (कोमल)

4. Venerable (आदरणीय): Immature (अपरिपक्व), Disrespectful (अनादरपूर्ण)

5. Venerate (सम्मान करना): Despise (घृणा करना), Disrespect (अनादर करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Somnolent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Awake.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Somnolent" means sleepy or drowsy; tending to induce sleep. (निद्रालु)

 

• "Awake" means not sleeping; alert and conscious. It is therefore the correct antonym. (जाग्रत)

◦ Example: The guard stayed awake throughout the night to keep watch over the warehouse.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Sleepy (नींद भरा) — ready or needing to sleep; a synonym of somnolent.

• Option 3: Lethargic (सुस्त) — lacking energy or enthusiasm; a synonym of somnolent.

• Option 4: Drowsy (उनींदा) — sleepy and lacking alertness; a synonym of somnolent.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of somnolent: Alert, Conscious, Vigilant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Venom (जहर): Benevolent (दयालुता), Antidote (विषनाशक)

2. Veracity (सत्यता): Falsehood (असत्य), Dishonesty (बेईमानी)

3. Veracity (सत्यता): Falsehood (असत्य), Lie (झूठ)

4. Veteran (अनुभवी): Novice (नवसिखुआ), Beginner (शुरुआती)

5. Vexatious (कष्टदायक / तंग करने वाला): Pleasant (सुखद), Comforting (आरामदायक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Appropriate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Improper.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Appropriate" means suitable or proper in the given circumstances. (उचित)

 

• "Improper" means not in accordance with accepted standards of behavior; unsuitable. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अनुचित)

◦ Example: Using slang during a formal presentation was seen as improper and left a poor impression on the panel.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Fitting (मुफ़ीद) — appropriate to the situation; a synonym of appropriate.

• Option 3: Proper (सही) — correct or appropriate in the circumstances; a synonym of appropriate.

• Option 4: Suitable (उपयुक्त) — right or appropriate for a particular situation; a synonym of appropriate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of appropriate: Unsuitable, Unfit, Wrong.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vigilant (सतर्क): Negligent (लापरवाह)

2. Vilify (बदनाम करना): Commend (प्रशंसा करना), Praise (सराहना)

3. Vindicate (निर्दोष साबित करना): Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Blame (दोष देना)

4. Violent (हिंसक): Gentle (कोमल), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण)

5. Vivacious (चंचल): Dull (नीरस), Lifeless (निष्प्राण)
